rationale: Bowin 2017 focuses on time-perception, not phantasia — extracted from Phantasia cluster per user directive. The article's central object is Aristotle's account of perceiving time in Physics 4.10-4.14 and De Memoria 1-2, with phantasia entering only instrumentally (as the medium through which time-content is presented to perception and through which deliberative phantasia synthesizes determinate time-units). Time-perception, the now (nun), the before-and-after structure (proteron-hysteron), counting (arithmein) versus measuring (metrein), and the circularity between memory and time-perception are the load-bearing topics; phantasia is auxiliary.
cross_pipeline_anchor: Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary (1985-2017) via De Memoria 1 450a19-22 phantasma passage — 'when someone is actively engaged in memory, he perceives in addition that he saw this, or heard it, or learned it before; and before and after are in time' — which makes phantasma the structural condition both for memory and for the perception of elapsed time. The bridge runs through Nussbaum (De Motu Animalium phantasia commentary), Frede ('Cognitive Role of Phantasia'), Caston ('Why Aristotle Needs Imagination'), and the De Memoria literature (King 2009, Sorabji 2004, Taormina 2002).
secondary_cross_pipeline_anchors: Aristotle - Complete Works pipeline: Physics IV.10-14 (217b29-224a17), De Anima III.3 + III.6 + III.10-11, De Memoria 1-2, De Insomniis 1-3, De Sensu 1, Metaphysics Α.1 + Δ.15 + Θ.10, Posterior Analytics II.19, Nicomachean Ethics VII.3

Heidegger - Basic Concepts of Aristotelian Philosophy (BCAP / GA 18): Heidegger's hexis-disposition reading of phronesis cuts against Bowin's Aristotelian time as countable; relevant for any dissertation engagement that places phantasia within the prior-posterior structure of the now

Dalton dissertation phantasia chapters: Bowin supplies the T0 motion/time pre-condition for any phantasia chapter that wants to argue phantasia is what individuates moments-as-past — the resonant kinesis / phantasma chain at A3 phantasma needs Bowin's circularity-thesis (memory presupposes time-perception, time-perception presupposes phantasma) as its non-vicious-circle structure

units.centerpiece_thesis: Perceiving time and grasping time intellectually are distinct modes of cognition; perceiving time does NOT presuppose grasping time intellectually, but grasping time intellectually DOES affect how rational beings perceive time. Memory and the perception of time presuppose each other, but the circle is broken by the De Memoria 1 (450a19-22) account whereby phantasmata supply the structural before-and-after that both memory and time-perception require.
